verdicts.reason: A shrinks the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark until they are barely readable. It sets the headline off-centre, leaving the left third of the banner empty, and wraps the CTA awkwardly onto two lines at the far right, where a background dot sits behind 'Line'. B keeps the original's centred stack with the logo, colours and hierarchy intact, but the vertical spacing is crammed. The CTA sits almost on the bottom edge, and the logo, headline and CTA are packed together with little breathing room. It also doesn't use the wide shape; it is just the centre column compressed into a banner.
